agents_view_permission.name: agents_view_permission
agents_view_permission.using:
organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer
      AND (
        owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid
        OR user_has_permission(
          current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
          'agents:view',
          organization_id,
          'agent',
          id
        )
      )

pages_authenticated_read.name: pages_authenticated_read
pages_authenticated_read.using:
is_public = true
      AND requires_auth = true
      AND current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        allowed_roles IS NULL
        OR allowed_roles = '{}'
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur
          JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
          WHERE ur.user_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)::uuid
          AND r.name = ANY(allowed_roles)
        )
      )

skills_view_permission.name: skills_view_permission
skills_view_permission.using:
organization_id = current_setting('app.current_organization_id')::integer
      AND (
        (agent_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM agents a
          WHERE a.id = agent_id
          AND (
            a.owner_id = current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid
            OR user_has_permission(
              current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
              'agents:view',
              a.organization_id,
              'agent',
              a.id
            )
          )
        ))
        OR
        (agent_id IS NULL AND user_has_permission(
          current_setting('app.current_user_id')::uuid,
          'skills:view',
          organization_id,
          'organization',
          organization_id
        ))
      )
